title: Contemporary Rule of Law Debates in the European Context
grammar: Sovereignty, Constitutional Identity, and European Integration
goal: I can explain what the debate between national sovereignty and European law is about, without taking a side.
I can explain what alkotmányos önazonosság and the primacy of European law mean.
I can use words such as bírói függetlenség and fékek és ellensúlyok.
